ebx.text:
The matrix multiplications in the TMUL instruction set compute:
for m < M: # Time steps for k < @tmul_maxk: # Grid height for n < @tmul_maxn: # SIMD dimension C[m][n] += VNNI_MUL(A[m][k], B[k][n])
